benchmark: Unchanged current-season Colley achievement, prior 2 centered on 0.5
challenger: Exact leave-one-game-out SOR using average source-designated FBS reference strength and venue
gameEligibility: Exactly the confirmed completed game set used by the contemporaneous published weekly snapshot
population: Same full opponent graph; publish research rows only for source-designated FBS teams, including unranked idle teams in the reference mean
nonFbsTies: Zero-outcome non-FBS context edges follow the source input policy and remain graph edges; FBS-involving ties require a new explicit policy and reject the research calculation
sourceCorrections: Documented source corrections are allowed under the shared input policy; record normalized input hash, policy version and raw-response hash. Never change a team's rank manually.
collection: Existing Sunday 08:00 America/Denver update; no additional provider requests; immutable observations in Git and source evidence in existing artifact
scope: Prospectively collected achievement comparisons are not pregame forecasts or proof that either achievement order is correct
changePolicy: A numerical implementation or parameter change requires a new version; do not rewrite prior observations
